proof_idea: Verify an absolute-value algo with exhaustive real sign cases; verify a square function and its nonnegativity theorem, two theorem instances and one computed value.

litex_code.computation:
algo absolute(x R) R by cases:
    case x >= 0: x
    case x < 0: -x
litex_code.graph:
have fn g(x R) R = x^2

thm square_nonnegative:
    ? forall x R:
        g(x) >= 0
    g(x) = x^2
    x^2 >= 0

by thm square_nonnegative(2) => g(2) >= 0

by thm square_nonnegative(-2) => g(-2) >= 0

g(2) = 4
